Title: Relates to enacting the "vehicle streaming device ban" act
Summary: Bans the sale of certain devices which allow video streaming on the center console or infotainment center of a motor vehicle which are in view of the driver, and the use of such devices while a vehicle is in motion.
LawCode: Add §392-l, Gen Bus L; amd §1225-d, V & T L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law and the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to enacting the "vehicle streaming device ban" act
